data_problems: THE BHAGYANGR SCORECARD ROW IS STILL WRONG AND THE ERROR IS STILL GROWING - NOW +18.3%. score.py snapped the 08-Oct-2026 DEMERGER ex-date gap (BSE close Rs 453.95 -> Rs 41.40, a ratio of 10.96x) to a SPLIT FACTOR OF 11 and divided the pre-08-Oct history by 11, restating that card's call close from the true Rs 444.90 to Rs 40.45. The row records the cause in its own adj_events field: '2026-10-08 x11 unrecorded gap x10.96'. A demerger is NOT a split: value left the scrip into Tieramet Limited, which allotted 3,34,96,434 shares 1:1 to BIL holders of record 08-Oct-2026 and HAS NOT YET LISTED, so this card's return is NOT MEASURABLE until it does, and no single adjustment factor can make it so. The misstatement is compounding as the stock moves: +7.4% on 09-Oct, +12.7% on 12-Oct, +18.3% today. Measured against the final scorecard, it is the SIXTH-highest return of 49 rows (behind KORE +35.5%, AMAL +23.2%, UTSSAV +23.1%, SHTL +20.6% and RIYAASAT +20.3%), so it does not sit inside the 5 rows counted as hit_20 - but it is a fabricated number inside a 49-row book whose median return is +1.3%, which is distortion enough. The fix needs a change to scripts/ideas/score.py, which this routine is explicitly forbidden to edit, so it has now been carried in three consecutive run logs without being fixed and will keep drifting until the owner changes the script. The specific change needed: treat an unrecorded gap as a split ONLY when no demerger/scheme-of-arrangement corporate action sits within a few days of it, and otherwise mark the row unmeasurable rather than snapping to the nearest standard factor.

THE ACTION'S SCAN FOR TODAY WAS AN HOUR TOO EARLY AND MISSED A CANDIDATE. feeds_status.json shows the ideas-feeds Action's scan step exiting 0 at 18:59 IST having read 917 of BSE's reported 917 - a COMPLETE read of what existed at that moment, not a capped one - but 85 more announcements were filed between 18:59 and this run's 19:54 re-read, among them GTPL Hathway's H1 FY27 results (19:25 IST) and its acquisition approval (19:29 IST), which make it the day's sixteenth candidate. The same thing happened on 2026-10-12, when the Action's capped 19:01 read missed RAJESH - the name that run went on to publish. This is a repeated pattern, not a one-off: the Action runs at 18:50 IST and Indian boards file results well past 19:00, so the routine's own re-scan is doing real work and must keep being run and committed. Moving ideas-feeds.yml's scan step later, or adding a second scan-only run around 21:00 IST, would catch these at source.

INNOMET'S 13-OCT EXPORT ORDER IS UNREADABLE AS FILED AND THE LEDGER EXCLUDES IT. The filing states the value once - 'Total Order/Contract Value including Packing/forwarding and other charges USD 29,592,26.' - with no amount in words, no quantity x rate and no annexure figure. order_wins.py read it as US$ 2,959,226 = Rs 28.34 cr at USD/INR 95.76, which would be about twice the company's entire stated order book of Rs 35.99 cr and six times its largest-ever single export order (US$ 1.49 mn), so that reading is not supportable; the plausible readings are US$ 29,592.26 and US$ 295,922.6, a 10x range. Recorded as UNKNOWN and excluded, making Innomet's confirmed sum of Rs 42.10 cr a floor. No guess was written. Worth a parser rule: reject a USD amount whose comma grouping is invalid rather than stripping the commas.
